name: Teidou Shirayuki
source:
Affiliation: Mahoshi Academy Latter Course 2nd Year.
Like: Flower, Reading, Cute (?) Doll.
Dislike: Sport, Other people.

One of Japan's foremost distinguished family Teidou daughter. She is quite, and has a cool personality that response bluntly with anyone. Basically, she doesn't like to be involved with people, and toward people who are persistently follow her, she would often drive them away with abusive language at the level that break hearts.

She used to be cheerful and innocent when she was young, but because she come from Teidou Family, many selfish people trying to get close to her ever since she was a child, nowadays she doesn't trust other people other than her family and her servant Nono.

Her exclusive servant Nono is her childhood friend, because of that she trust her completely and always come to her for consultation or to grumble.

She is [url=https://vndb.org/c36325]Teido Setsuka[/url] relatives from 『Uso Series』

「I have no interest toward you.  Please get out of my sight immediately」
